name: Erik Marquardt - § 96 - Am 36
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union Agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text: 96. Urges the Agency to fully clarify all open issues, to implement OLAF recommendations in a credible and transparent manner, and to establish robust internal control, ethical oversight, and accountability mechanisms; calls on the Agency to inform the discharge authority about any remedial steps taken without undue delays;
